findings.evidence: Original project/service receipts contain generic budget guides, seller pages, broad tenders and inaccessible social routes. New queries quote supplied topic terms and prioritize buyer-brief wording; live yield improvement remains unverified.
Existing public-document-v7 primary buyer capture repair is retained. Earlier seeded live recapture yielded a recommendation; that was not fresh discovery.

Service targets previously required every lexeme. An isolated database regression now retrieves a React/TypeScript dashboard missing generic web/development words, keeps exact matches first, and still honors hiding, freshness and downstream fit.

Saved model output asserted a currency conflict despite minimumPay being empty. This was a misleading criterion/rank penalty, not the sole reason that request was rejected. Policy now marks such a conflict unknown; explicit minima and eligibility remain enforced.

Both fresh baseline runs failed before obtaining any leads. Minimal connectivity diagnostics returned Serper HTTP 400 Not enough credits and model HTTP 429 credit_balance_exhausted. These are execution failures, not discovery-quality scores.

runs.limitations: AI estimates exclude unpriced/failed attempts, infrastructure and billing adjustments. Search reservations are configured upper allowances, not invoices. Source labels and dashboard acceptance are not independent usefulness judgments. Distinct URLs may still describe the same opportunity; repeatedDestinations detects only observed redirect identity. Initial reports recorded a dashboard sample, not every source review.
